notes: The 'two separate groups' finding is not a real problem for this manual. The booklet builds three independent models: the red car (pp3-4), the blue Toys R Us truck (pp5-7) and the store (pp8-36). p37 only shows them standing side by side. Nothing in the steps joins one to another, so I left them unconnected rather than invent joins.

The only link between any of them is the single sticker sheet (b27; the inventory has one sheet). It is applied to the truck tile (b26) and to the store sign tile (b162), so the truck and the store come out as one group and the red car as the other. That link comes from the one shared sticker node and is not a physical connection between the models.
All 165 parts of the inventory appear once as b1-b165 in build order: car b1-b10, truck b11-b27, store b28-b165.
Stacks and pairs that the manual builds several times (clear/yellow 1x1 plate stacks, wheels) are listed individually instead of as repeats, to keep ids tied to the inventory.

Stud-level ports are left null for most joins because the small pictures do not show which exact studs are used. Exact positions are approximate and were inferred from the pictures. Wheels are shown clipped to the 4081b clip plates.
Truck chassis is built upside-down in steps 1-3 and flipped in step 4. In the final orientation clear plates are at the bottom, then the black clip/1x1 plates, then the blue 1x3 plate on top.

Store base 2 (b37) is attached by sitting under the overhanging 2x2 plates of step 3. The two Technic pins (b89, b90) are pushed into the right-hand Technic brick b88; the left Technic brick b87 has empty holes.
